net/tcp_racing#

Happy Eyeballs over numeric candidates (RFC 8305): attempts start a stagger apart, families interleave, and the first connection wins while the others are cancelled and closed.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Happy Eyeballs over numeric candidates (RFC 8305): attempts start a stagger apart, families interleave, and the first connection wins while the others are cancelled and closed. The engine lives in net/tcp, where TcpConnecting(host:, port:) races the resolver's addresses the same way.

Public API#

object TcpRacing#

object TcpRacing

Happy Eyeballs (RFC 8305): attempts on several addresses, started a stagger apart, the first to connect wins.

TcpRacing.TcpRacing#

Races origins with the default stagger.

TcpRacing.TcpRacing#

TcpRacing(origins is Sequencing<IpEndpoint>, options is TcpOptions, delay is Duration, clock is Timing)

Races origins delay apart with options on clock.

The first connection made; the others are closed.
